# Original browser media fixture

`procedural-vp8-opus.webm` is generated solely from canvas drawing/text and an oscillator by [the generator](../../../scripts/generate-legal-media.mjs). `english.vtt` is original fixture text. These test-media files are dedicated to the public domain under [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/); no third-party film, music, artwork, stream URL or account data is used. Generator source follows the repository license.

Run `node scripts/generate-legal-media.mjs` from the repository root with pinned Node and the installed Playwright Chromium. Generation uses no external network. Recording timing/bytes can vary; [provenance](provenance.json) records the actual output hash, size and generator version. This is a small transport/playback fixture, not 1080p/4K/HDR, multitrack or cross-device evidence.
